method: Visual topic-anchor review; independently authored lesson text and original schematic diagrams. Source dimensions/standards lists are not treated as universal requirements. No copied source illustrations.
authoring_decisions: Foam density is not equated with firmness; support data and assembly trials required.
Module grid arithmetic does not approve stacking or stability.
Overall seating width does not establish comfortable occupancy.
Transition envelope and simultaneous use reviewed in multifunction furniture.
Cover substitutions and support changes have separate approval requirements.

arithmetic_assumptions.M08-L02: Four 400 mm external modules, no intermediate gaps: 1600 mm single row or 800 mm two-unit row. Stackability unverified.
arithmetic_assumptions.M09-L02: 1800 mm external width minus two 100 mm arms gives 1600 mm; two 150 mm arms give 1500 mm. Geometry only.
